name: good-neighbour
description: Is your camera being a good neighbour? Finds what a Ring camera records that is not yours and suggests the privacy zones to add. Ring API + Amazon Bedrock (Qwen3-VL).

paragraphs: A Ring doorbell sees more than its owner's home: the street, the pavement, the house across the road. Ring lets owners hide those parts with privacy zones, but they have to notice the problem and draw every zone by hand. Good Neighbour looks at what the camera actually sees, finds the parts that are not the owner's, checks them against the zones already set, and suggests the ones that are missing.
Try it: (press a sample photo, check your own, or paste a Ring access token to use your camera's live view).
Built for the Ring track of the Build, Ship, Shape: Amazon Developer Hackathon 2026, with the AWS Builder and Open Source mini challenges.
